experiment_data.hypothesis: Fixed 50/50 real-synthetic mixing provides intermediate collapse mitigation compared to pure collapse (0% real) but underperforms spectral-guided adaptive mixing (exp_003), because uniform allocation wastes real data budget on early generations where collapse signals are weak

spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/spectral_collapse_ews && CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 python run_phase1.py --condition fixed_mix --seed 42 --generations 10 --signal log_det --tau 0.002 --k 0 --signal_mode per_gen --gpu 0"
spec.description: Phase 1: Fixed 50/50 real-synthetic mixing (baseline condition), seed 42
